beasts.name: Giganticlaw
beasts.description:
Small, weak Monsters that are most often found
roaming across open and rocky areas, Giganticlaws
are primarily notable because of their tendency to
eat anything that isn’t dirt or rocks.
They are known to cause problems for convoys and
transports which stop for the night in areas where
they are prevalent – they will frequently latch onto
the vehicles, eating their tires, canvas sides and
other soft parts. Any cargo that’s contained within
containers that they can pry open with their claws is
also at risk.
Giganticlaws are considered a pest, but a
reasonably useful source of Crystals for Stardust,
Inc. power plants. As they often travel in small
groups, attracted to anything that vibrates or makes
a noise, it is possible to gather them with a little
effort.
Measuring about 0.4 metres long, their claw is the
only threat they offer to anyone they might attack, as
they don’t seem to have access to any Magic.
They are relatively weak, and even beginner fighters
are able to dispatch a Giganticlaw with little difficulty

beasts.name: Selians
beasts.description: Selians are person-sized, semi-intelligent creatures which live in the sewers below major cities as well as in swampy areas. They are ferocious combatants, and often attack in numbers, using Spells which put their prey to sleep, making them easier targets. They also possess glands capable of producing large amounts of acid at a moment’s notice, making even a brief encounter with this type of Monster potentially fatal to an unprepared adventurer. Although they seldom move stealthily, they often conceal themselves under water, leaping out with great speed and accuracy the moment anyone strays too close. Althougn Stardust, Inc. has made an effort to eliminate them from the sewers below Stardust City, it has been unable to do so entirely. Instead, personnel often reinforce doors and barricade entrances to the sewers, both to keep Selians in and the population of the city out! Measuring around 1.5 metres in height, Selians don’t often stray too far from water, despite being able to breathe air, because they need to keep their skin moist in order to survive.

beasts.name: Zoloid
beasts.description:
Small and weak Monsters that are commonly found
across the world, Zoloids can compress their bodies,
allowing them squeeze through almost any gap
large enough to fit their bone spikes. In the cities,
they are considered vermin – unfortunately, they can
get almost anywhere, by passing through the water
pipes and ducts that connect buildings.
Zoloids will eat almost anything, although they seem
to prefer dead creatures and what others throw
away to anything that the population consider edible
food.
Zoloids were quickly deemed uninteresting by
Stardust, Inc. and a general attitude of killing them
when encountered was mandated to take their
Crystals and use them for Stardust, Inc.’s power
plants.
Measuring only about 0.3 metres high, their
tentacles are capable of giving unprepared attackers
a weak slap, and they command basic Ice Magic,
which they use to defend themselves.
It’s occasionally known for Mutation Magic wielding
Ethereals and Spell Sphere manufacturers to seek
out Zoloids and provoke them into attacking to gain
the power of the Icicles Spell. Spell Spheres from
Zoloids are relatively common and cheap, as Zoloids
are one of the weakest possible users of this Spell.
